reason: Expert identifies a known false alarm for a battery alarm during severe cold weather due to a temperature sensor glitch.

knowledge.summary: Battery alarms during severe cold weather can be false alarms caused by the temperature sensor failing at very low temperatures; check the temperature sensor reading and do not dispatch anyone if the battery voltage is normal.
knowledge.author: Sanna Siirto
knowledge.details: Sensor may report unrealistic values like -40 in extreme cold while battery voltage remains normal.
